system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Only tools that pass validation within a fixed number of attempts are exposed to the agent at runtime.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt/action space varies with discovered per-site tools; no prompt file shown.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we store trajectory summaries in a vector database keyed by task intent; at run time we embed the current intent and append the nearest summary in the DB
env_context_strategy.note: Embedding retrieval of prior summaries plus agent browsing/DOM parsing.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Observations include a page screenshot with indexed Set-of-Mark (SoM) boxes and a list of interactive elements keyed by the same indices.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Once validated, tools are exposed to the policy as atomic actions that augment the agent's vocabulary.
tool_call_format.note: Call syntax not specified; inferred from schema-based tool invocation.

tool_count.note: Over 50 tools discovered across sites; per-run default tool count not stated.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: a browser action executor (GPT-5-mini) using standard web actions (click, type, navigate, etc.)
edit_primitive.note: Browser agent; no file editing tool.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Btool induces an input schema S inp with rich validation and support for diverse datatypes (e.g. enums for dropdown menus), optional fields, and usage examples

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Hybrid integration with official APIs when available, external MCP servers (Luo et al., 2025), and more agent-accessible observation spaces
protocol_standardization.note: MCP named only as future work.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: we pair a VLM planner (GPT-5) with a browser action executor (GPT-5-mini)
loop_primitives.note: Offline demonstrate-generate-validate loop is generate_test_repair; runtime replans every 15 steps.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: run for at most 30 steps, and replan every 15
planning_granularity.note: Planner exists but no stored plan object described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a specialized tool construction agent B tool that collaborates with the browser agent B browser
multi_agent_topology.note: Also planner+executor split and verifier LLM at runtime.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: agentic fallback - a last resort that spawns a fresh agent to handle a failing action script on the fly

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Agents authenticate to each site before execution, run for at most 30 steps
human_in_loop.note: No human approval described; human demos only as an ablation upper bound.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: State is maintained via a multimodal message queue.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: we store trajectory summaries in a vector database keyed by task intent
long_term_memory.note: Validated tools persisted across runs form a skill/tool library.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We use GPT-5-mini as the verification LLM following the design of WebJudge
self_verification.note: Offline tools validated against pre-vetted test inputs.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The process iterates—updating the tool and test set with feedback—until a validated u* is obtained or the attempt budget is exhausted.
retry_policy.note: Retry budget applies to tool construction, not task attempts.

rollback.evidence_quote: a last resort that spawns a fresh agent to handle a failing action script on the fly

termination_condition.evidence_quote: run for at most 30 steps, and replan every 15
termination_condition.note: Self-reported task outcome is corroborated by the verifier.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: For our base agent, we pair a VLM planner (GPT-5 OpenAI (2025)) with a browser action executor (GPT-5-mini) using standard web actions
cost_controls.note: Cheaper executor model is a design choice, not a routing/budget mechanism; no caps reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Implementations build on browser-use (Browser-Use Team, 2024a) and workflow-use libraries

network_policy.evidence_quote: Agents authenticate to each site before execution
network_policy.note: No egress restriction mentioned; agent browses benchmark sites.

permission_model.evidence_quote: tools are exposed to the policy as atomic actions that augment the agent's vocabulary

tracing.evidence_quote: tools carry explicit contracts, examples, and validation traces, making web agents easier to monitor, share, and maintain as sites evolve

replayability.evidence_quote: we explicitly prioritize discovering stable DOM selectors and store element hashes to allow for deterministic replay

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Our code will be made publicly available.
eval_hooks.note: No released repo at coding time; evaluation uses external VWA/WebArena evaluators.

guardrails.evidence_quote: tools that accept a validated input schema and accomplish a specific goal
guardrails.note: Schema validation gates tool execution; no safety filters described.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Web agents promise to automate complex browser tasks

open_source.evidence_quote: Our code will be made publicly available.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We first vary the LLM execution agent
